s.en: print resolved symbolic links or canonical file names
s.es: muestra a dónde apunta un enlace simbólico

o.es: Resuelve la ruta completa siguiendo todos los enlaces (el destino debe existir salvo el último componente).
Como -f pero todos los componentes deben existir.
o.en: Like -f but every component must exist.
canonicalize by following every symlink in every component of the given name recursively, without requirements on components existence
do not output the trailing delimiter
suppress most error messages (on by default if POSIXLY_CORRECT is not set)
report error messages (on by default if POSIXLY_CORRECT is set)
end each output line with NUL, not newline
